caption: In the last months of pregnancy, a baby’s muscles begin to strengthen and curl into the fetal position.  When they’re born, their muscles are still flexed (which is totally normal). That’s why their arms and legs naturally bend in, and sometimes, when you lay them down, their muscles contract. That contraction causes them to scrunch or even roll slightly to the side.  Parents often wonder if their newborn is already learning to roll, but this newborn curl is not a sign of rolling. It’s one of those sweet newborn reflexes that fades as they grow, so soak it in while it lasts! newborn scrunch | newborn curl vs rolling | newborn curl reflex | when do babies roll | newborn rolling to side | baby scrunch
